# 3ngram v1.7.0

Minor: two read endpoints for session-run bookkeeping, a consolidation queue
that finally settles, and overdue commitments that stay visible instead of
expiring on the next sweep.

## Changes

- **Read endpoints for agent-session rows and triage attempts** (#203, #215).
  `GET /api/v1/agent-sessions/{sessionRunId}` returns the bookkeeping row
  (identity, lifecycle timestamps, `activation_epoch`, triage status,
  `briefed_memories`; never the excerpt or the watermark ids) and
  `GET /api/v1/agent-sessions/{sessionRunId}/triage-attempts` returns the
  run's interactive nudge history. Both are read-only and tenant-scoped, and
  share the events endpoint's id boundary and error mapping. The history is
  persisted by migration `0037_triage_attempt_log`: one entry per armed
  Stop-nudge attempt, bounded at 50 with `triage_attempt_count` keeping the
  true total. The closer's claims are deliberately not logged.

- **Consolidation no longer re-proposes a settled pair** (#220, #231).
  `findSimilarPairs` never consulted `consolidation_proposals` or
  `memory_edges`, so a pair a reviewer rejected came back on the next hourly
  run and an applied `extends`/`derives` pair, whose endpoints both stay live,
  was re-proposed forever. Production logs showed the same 218 candidate
  pairs and zero new proposals on 121 consecutive runs. A pair with a proposal
  in any status, or with a materialized edge, in either orientation, is now
  excluded at candidate time. A rejection is final for that pair; only a new
  memory id reopens the question.

- **Overdue commitments stay open for a grace window** (#221, #232). The
  15-minute surfacing sweep expired every open or waiting commitment the
  moment `due_at` passed, and no briefing section reads `expired`, so an
  overdue item was visible for at most one tick. A new worker setting,
  `COMMITMENT_EXPIRY_GRACE_DAYS` (default 14; `0` restores the previous
  behaviour; a blank value counts as unset), keeps the commitment open, and
  therefore overdue in the briefing, for that many days before the worker
  expires it. Library callers of `surface()` and `sweepCommitments()` that
  omit the new optional argument keep the previous immediate-expiry
  semantics; `loadSurfacingConfig()`, `SurfacingPolicy`, `expiryCutoff()`
  and `LEGACY_SURFACING_POLICY` are new exports.

## Operations

One migration: `0037_triage_attempt_log` (schema head moves from `0036` to
`0037`). Run it before the server promote, as the deploy runbook requires.
The worker gains one optional environment variable,
`COMMITMENT_EXPIRY_GRACE_DAYS`; both Compose stacks pass it through. Both
triage mechanisms (`SESSION_CLOSER_ENABLED`, `THREENGRAM_STOP_NUDGE`) remain
**default-off** pending the #166 validation bar.
